translation_notes: prefixes: RDF->rdf, RDFS->rdfs, XSD->xsd (rdf/rdfs unused by the region itself)
val is not a string constant, so the bare `{expr}^^dt` term form (only valid in graph term position) does not apply; used f{Literal(val, datatype=xsd:dateTime)} per migrate-from-rdflib trap 1

graph.set/.remove kept as plain rdflib calls: self.edit() yields an opaque editable graph, not a @graph-declared one, and .set/.remove(pattern-with-None) are outside the add_isolated/remove strata this region targets
context shim namespace.py restores KTBS (relative import `..namespace` cannot resolve when the region is executed standalone)
optimization_notes: optimized.py is original.py: one graph.set and one graph.remove, nothing to compress.

optimized.ldpy: XSD.dateTime becomes the prefixed name xsd:dateTime (header @prefix); the translation's f{Literal(...)} wrapper is dropped (a no-op passthrough). graph.set and graph.remove stay rdflib calls: set has no island (it would cost a -{ } plus a +{ }), the editable graph from self.edit() would need an @graph line, and designating it binds the block's prefixes onto it.
The notation ratio above 1 comes from the unoptimized header's @prefix xsd line; the region lines themselves are two tokens shorter.
header_optimization_notes: Python: Graph, RDF, RDFS and URIRef go.
LD Python: Graph, RDF, RDFS, URIRef and XSD go; @prefix xsd is used.
